name: centroid_v1 addendum: hard Nearest forward + Centroid backward
status: written before the run; requested by the user ('只做一个：Nearest 前向 + Centroid 反向'); the only run of this addendum
question: Is the FW-Centroid K4 training gap (+0.142 vs strict FW-Prob K4 at seed 7) caused by the Centroid backward or by the Centroid forward?
operator: approx nearest_centroid_bwd in code/centroid_root_v2: P = P_N.detach() + (P_C - P_C.detach()); P_N the strict hard FW-Nearest probabilities (bitwise equal to the E2 strict Prob-STE root's forward, check V2), P_C the normalized Centroid probabilities on the same K+1 Nearest cells (FW tau 6, zero tail). Same surrogate placement as strict Prob-STE; only the surrogate branch (LERP -> Centroid) differs.

run.name: cv1b_s7_fw_nearestfwd_centroidbwd_k4_tau6_100m
run.recipe: identical to the four centroid_v1 runs (124M, WikiText-103, 100M tokens, seed 7, local RTX 3090, bta env, eval every 5M on 100 batches for logging)

evaluation: 20/40/60/80/100M checkpoints with code/eval_v2 (copy of code/eval; the geometry probe treats this mode as Nearest), full validation 243 blocks, batch 1, bf16 autocast outside fp32 attention, TF32 off, local 3090

decomposition_100M.B_backward_effect: NfCb - FWM-Prob K4 strict (same strict hard Nearest forward; Centroid vs LERP Jacobian)
decomposition_100M.F_forward_effect: FW-Centroid - NfCb (same Centroid backward; Centroid vs Nearest forward)
decomposition_100M.total: FW-Centroid - FWM-Prob K4 strict = B + F
decomposition_100M.backward_share: B / total, from the same circular moving-block resamples for all three per-block arrays (block 16, 4000 resamples, RNG 20260920)

decision_rules.backward_dominated: CI of B excludes 0 and backward_share point estimate >= 0.75
decision_rules.forward_dominated: CI of F excludes 0 and backward_share point estimate <= 0.25
decision_rules.mixed: otherwise; report B, F and the share with intervals
decision_rules.labels: per-contrast labels as in protocol_centroid_v1.json (not_separable / suggestive / clear_single_seed, Exact seed SD 0.0062)

secondary: NfCb - FWM-Weight K4 hist (same local 3090 stack)
caveats_declared_in_advance: single seed; evaluation CIs cover validation sampling only

the strict FWM-Prob control was trained on the gpu-host-A RTX 5090, the new run and FW-Centroid on the local 3090; previously audited stack effects are <= ~0.01, so B and F smaller than about 0.02 are not interpreted as mechanism evidence
the five-seed FWM-Prob K4 mean (+0.013, SD 0.009) is quoted as a second reference for the Nearest-forward/LERP-backward level
no_adaptive_changes: no early stopping, no further runs decided from this result
compute: one run, about 5.5 h on the local 3090 alone, plus 5 checkpoint evaluations
